name: – Anna Strolenberg – § 122 – § 59
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 122. Recalls that the well-being of Europe’s peoples is the sole responsibility of sovereign Member States and firmly rejects any further encroachment by EU institutions into areas such as social policy, health and welfare; calls on the Commission to cease competence creep, to strictly respect subsidiarity and to leave such matters to be determined at national level in line with each country’s own priorities and democratic will;
